section: full manuscript structural and close-read audit

claims.text: JOSS, ReScience, CODECHECK, and ACM artifact policies expose different review objects and warrant different conclusions.
claims.rhetorical_role: establish component landscape without creating a straw man
claims.evidence: Primary system papers and official ACM policy
claims.caveat: The paper does not compare effectiveness.
claims.unresolved_question: Complete feature-level source locators before G1.

claims.text: The two-layer architecture separates shared evidence from local reliance views.
claims.evidence: Design derivation and prior-art packet, not empirical validation
claims.citation: none required for description; component citations appear in landscape
claims.caveat: Proposed profile, not demonstrated superior architecture.
claims.unresolved_question: Can standards crosswalk and cases implement it without ad hoc exceptions?

claims.text: The five-part epistemic ladder is an operational normalization rather than universal terminology.
claims.evidence: NASEM and ACM support distinctions but not this exact ladder
claims.caveat: Communities use reproducibility and replicability differently.
claims.unresolved_question: Human domain review of terminology required.

claims.text: Human and agent intelligence belong in the multiaxis resource declaration.
claims.caveat: No scalar exchange rate or effectiveness claim is made.
claims.unresolved_question: What burden and reliability fields prove usable in implementation?

claims.text: The worked cases are design walkthroughs, not implementation results.
claims.evidence: No executable case artifacts are present; evidence gates say so explicitly.
claims.unresolved_question: Which public fixtures will be instantiated?

claims.text: Machine checks report conformance and discrepancies; they do not certify scientific validity.
claims.evidence: Conservative scope inferred from computational-review sources and scientific-validity definition
claims.caveat: Humans also do not guarantee correctness.
claims.unresolved_question: Independent scientific reviewer should test wording.

claims.text: Plural local trust improves scientific peer review.
claims.evidence: No scientific-review comparison in supplied sources
claims.caveat: Recommender-system results do not transfer automatically.

claims.text: Polycentric governance is used as an institutional lens, not an empirical endorsement.
claims.evidence: Ostrom source plus explicit manuscript caveat
claims.unresolved_question: Which governance failure modes dominate in practice?

claims.text: The architecture is the first to join provenance and plural trust governance.
claims.evidence: Gap audit incomplete; closest-work matrix shows preemption
claims.caveat: Contribution posture is synthesis and consolidation.

claims.text: Executable-publication, continuous-analysis, workflow-platform, and dependency-capture systems already implement substantial parts of the proposed record.
claims.rhetorical_role: narrow novelty and identify components to reuse
claims.evidence: Primary papers for Jupyter, continuous analysis, Whole Tale, Galaxy, and ReproZip, with dated feature-level locators in CLOSEST_WORK_CROSSWALK.md
claims.caveat: No exhaustiveness or comparative-effectiveness claim; absence from checked sources is not absence from later implementations.
claims.unresolved_question: A wider independent search remains required before any broad novelty claim.

claims.text: Existing review-event, correction, versioning, serialization, and PID standards cover complementary lifecycle layers but do not natively encode the full MCRP scientific-review event.
claims.rhetorical_role: bound interoperability contribution and prevent reinvention
claims.evidence: Official and normative feature-level scopes, fields, relations, and non-goals recorded in CLOSEST_WORK_CROSSWALK.md v0.2
claims.citation: niso-peer-review-2023; coar-notify-1.0.1; docmaps-framework-2021; crossref-peer-review-2026; crossref-crossmark-2026; niso-jav-2008; niso-crec-2024; jats-1.4; datacite-schema-4.7
claims.caveat: The audit is targeted, not exhaustive; richer implementations or extensions may exist.
claims.unresolved_question: Can a worked record project into each selected standard with every loss made explicit?

claims.text: The attached public R0 packet is a bounded implementation observation of identity-checked computational repeatability and one necessary lag invariant, not an independent replication or scientific-validity result.
claims.rhetorical_role: replace the portable-case placeholder with measured evidence while bounding its epistemic ceiling
claims.evidence: Registered GWOSC-v2 source identities, frozen workflow configuration, clean replay, eight passing conformance/adversarial tests, recorded claim evidence, and ten-axis resource observation
claims.caveat: Human domain sign-off, independent clean-checkout replay, archive minting, and validation of accepted external products and libraries are pending.
claims.unresolved_question: Will a qualified gravitational-wave reviewer accept the preprocessing, boundary declarations, and conclusion strength?

claims.text: A fresh-context detached-checkout replay supplies separate computational custody but not independent implementation, input, institution, scientific judgment, or replication.
claims.rhetorical_role: decompose independence and prevent a clean rerun from being inflated into replication
claims.evidence: Independent replay report IR001, clean checkout, locked replay, packet audit, adversarial mutations, discrepancy list, and explicit independence-dimension vector
claims.caveat: The executor is a fresh-context agent commissioned within the same private activity and has no human gravitational-wave authority.
claims.unresolved_question: Which additional organizational, implementation, data, or scientific-independence dimensions should a relying domain require?
